`LOCKED` is the completion black hole, and other flags are set with `|=` from many places: an owner-aware completion lock for `LOCKED`, and atomic flag updates (a `VarHandle` CAS) once the symbol is published.
The current phase, read by every `info` and period check: per-thread (Scratch), with `enteringPhase`/`exitingPhase` saving and restoring it per thread.
The period cached from `ph` and the run id: moves with `ph`, so per-thread too.
The run's phase cursor: keep it fixed while the parallel typer runs, written only between phases on the driver thread.

Grown by `enterChars` under `nameLock` when `synchronizeNames`, but `Name.toString` and `chrs` read it without the lock: a reader can see a replaced array mid-copy. Publish the grown array with a volatile write, or read under the lock.
Rebuilt on read and nulled by `enter`: a benign race only if read once into a local and the scope is frozen once its owner's completion publishes it.

column1: # -Yparallel-typer (stage 1): protection of the fields the parallel typer touches or relies on. Protections: thread-confined, synchronized, concurrent, volatile, atomic, completion-lock (under the completion lock, or reached only inside a completion), pre-pass (written by source completers, which run serially before the workers), publication (published after its fields, with a fence), thread-safe-holder (one immutable holder), benign-race (idempotent or diagnostic only), driver (written by the driver outside the parallel phase), rejected-option (only with an option that -Yparallel-typer rejects), batch-only.

column1: # A `Context` is confined to the typing that made it. Completers capture namer contexts and run on whichever thread forces the symbol, but every completer types on a context of its own (`createNamer`'s `makeNewScope`, `Namer.completerTyper`, `makeNonSilent`/`makeSilent` for annotations), so a namer context is only read once the namer is done: `make` copies its fields. Exceptions, benign: `savingEnclClass`, and the implicits cache below.
